svg.aria-label: Cover: the getaway at night. The animal control van has pulled up at the kerb and the warden runs with his net under a street lamp, while the gang go over a tagged garden fence with the loot: Tilly with a slice of cake, Big Biscuit with a whole roast chicken, Mags with a gold watch, Velvet already away, and Pip tumbling head over heels just ahead of the net, which catches only the drumstick she dropped
